reference: The terminal was empty; even so, she felt watched.
sk: Terminál bol prázdny; aj tak mala pocit, že ju niekto sleduje.
cz: Terminál byl prázdný; přesto měla pocit, že ji někdo sleduje.
acceptable: The terminal was {empty|deserted}; {even so|nevertheless|nonetheless|still}, she felt {watched|like someone was watching her|as if someone was watching her|as if someone were watching her|that someone was watching her|like she was being watched|as if she was being watched}.
The terminal was {empty|deserted}; {even so|nevertheless|nonetheless|still}, she had the {feeling|sense} that {someone|somebody} was watching her.

mistakes.text: The terminal was empty; {even though|even if}, she felt watched.
mistakes.kind: even though instead of even so
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Even though“ a „even if“ uvádzajú vedľajšiu vetu; samostatne za bodkočiarkou patrí „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Even though“ a „even if“ uvádějí vedlejší větu; samostatně za středníkem patří „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Even though” and “even if” start a clause; alone after a semicolon use “even so”.

mistakes.text: The terminal was empty; although, she felt watched.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Although“ nemôže stáť samo za bodkočiarkou; význam „aj tak“ má „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Although“ nemůže stát samo za středníkem; význam „přesto“ má „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Although” can't stand alone after a semicolon; for “all the same” use “even so”.

mistakes.text: The terminal was {empty|deserted}; however, she felt watched.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „However“ vyjadruje len kontrast; význam „aj tak“ presnejšie vystihuje „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „However“ vyjadřuje jen kontrast; význam „přesto“ přesněji vystihuje „even so“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “However” only contrasts; “even so” better keeps the meaning “in spite of that”.

mistakes.text: The terminal was {empty|deserted}, but she felt watched.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Tu sa precvičuje linker „even so“ namiesto jednoduchého „but“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Tady se procvičuje linker „even so“ místo jednoduchého „but“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Here practise the linker “even so” instead of the simple “but”.

mistakes.text: The terminal was {empty|deserted}; even so, she felt watching.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Felt watching“ znamená, že sleduje ona. Pocit, že ju niekto sleduje, je „felt watched“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Felt watching“ znamená, že sleduje ona. Pocit, že ji někdo sleduje, je „felt watched“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Felt watching” means she is the one watching; being observed is “felt watched”.

source_issues: SK uses 'aj tak' (even so), CZ uses 'přesto' (nevertheless); both linkers accepted.
